content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real), Type.judge(@N, Nat)), Analysis.taylorPoly(F, x, N), Analysis.taylorPoly(F, x, N))

values.en: The polynomial of degree at most `N` whose derivatives at `x₀` up to order `N` agree with those of `F`, namely `Σ_{k=0}^{N} F⁽ᵏ⁾(x₀)/k! · (x − x₀)ᵏ`. It is the unique such polynomial, which is the cleanest characterisation and explains why the coefficients must be what they are.
values.zh-CN: 次数至多为 `N`、且在 `x₀` 处直至 `N` 阶的各阶导数均与 `F` 相同的多项式，即 `Σ_{k=0}^{N} F⁽ᵏ⁾(x₀)/k! · (x − x₀)ᵏ`。它是唯一满足这些条件的多项式；这是最简洁的刻画，也说明了系数为何必然取这些值。
